newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
** Transaction fees on the Jakarta stock exchange were expected to be the cheapest in Southeast Asian region by the year 1998, exchange president commissioner Fuad Bawazier said.
** The Dow Jones industrial average fell 34.29 points to close at 5,972.73 on Monday as investors awaited fresh economic data.
** The Jakarta composite index fell 5.09 points, or 0.89 percent, to close at 566.25 on Monday, but brokers said interest in car maker Astra kept it from a steep decline.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,327.65/28.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,327.50/28.25.
** Automobile conglomerate Astra on reports that the firm was expected to issue a 400 billion rupiah bond in November to strengthen its finance.
** Property firm Suryamas Duta Makmur on market talk of a possible rights issue.
** Property firm Ometraco Realty on a plan to acquire privately-owned property firms PT Angkasa Interland and PT Lestari Basuki.
** Secondliner Intraco Penta on reports of a stock split to 500 rupiah from 1,000 rupiah.
** Bank Niaga on announcement of a 103.9 billion rupiah rights issue.
** Energy firm Medco Energy on newspaper reports of a possible link-up with a foreign firm, possibly a Malaysian mining firm.
